sentences.text: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the  respondents 1 to 4 to provide adequate compensation with appropriat  interest by re-measuring the property including superstructure of t  petitioner in S.F.No.107/1 corresponding New T.S.No.107/8 in Block  XXIII-B1 situated Kokkulappi Village, Madurai Corporation based on  the petitioner's representation dated 08.07.2025.
For Petitioner : M/s.M.Viji  For Respondents : Mr.K.Balasubramani  Special Government Pleader  ORDER Heard both sides.
2. 68 Sq.mts of land belonging to the writ petitioner have been acquired under the Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Even though a lesser extent of land alone is being acquired, the entire building situated on a larger extent has to be demolished.
The building in question consists of both a ground floor as well as first floor.
The ground floor measures 128.38 sq.mts and the first floor measures 100.5 sq.mts.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The authorities are not right in holding that the first floor will not be valued.
The first floor may be excluded in valuation only if it consists a terrace portion.
But if there is a building in the first floor, then it has to be valued.
I am not going into the valuation aspect.

I am only directing the second respondent to value the building for the ground floor as well as the first floor and also the land in question and pay compensation to the writ petitioner before the writ petitioner is dispossessed.
3. This writ petition is allowed accordingly.
There shall be no order as to costs.
